subject: Seal degradation after hot cleaning-water duty
symptoms: Progressive seal leakage observed after several months of continuous hot-duty operation.
diagnosis: Pump hydraulic and casing conditions were within the HX-240 envelope. The installed EPDM seal was operating above its 90°C continuous guidance.
resolution: Replaced EPDM seal with FKM. Confirmed shaft condition and alignment. Recommended 2,000-hour seal inspection interval in hot chemical service.
service_lesson: When HX-240 runs above 90°C continuously, do not recommend the standard EPDM seal.
